ChordLoop does not require an account, does not ask you to sign in, and does not collect or sell personal information. Everything you create in the app is stored on your device.

The app makes no network connections at all. The only files it loads are the ones shipped inside it.

There is no advertising, no tracking, and no third-party analytics in the app. Nothing you do in it is profiled or sold.

Deleting the app removes everything it kept on your device. Questions about privacy? Email jonathanbbiles@gmail.com.
